title: A Portrait for the Cipher
author: Quentin Eastwick
blurb: Quentin Ashgrove, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
